# Bitcoin Core GUI — Supported Features

Feature comparison of the Qt Widgets GUI in **`bitcoin-core/gui`** and the **`qt6` branch of `bitcoin-core/gui-qml`**, checked October 8, 2026.

- Qt Widgets baseline: [`master` at `f739c7876b81304bdc72e7eaa307702da269ac31`](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui/commit/f739c7876b81304bdc72e7eaa307702da269ac31).
- GUI-QML comparison: [`qt6` at `a91f4b4774f25de061fe1a7c132a91ddde117fca`](https://github.com/bitcoin-core/gui-qml/commit/a91f4b4774f25de061fe1a7c132a91ddde117fca), confirmed against the upstream branch on the review date.

Subfeatures describe user capabilities and outcomes, including copying to the clipboard and importing or exporting files. Control placement and step-by-step activation details are omitted. Support notes retain meaningful limits involving wallet types, compatibility, platforms, and advanced setup.

The QML column compares reachable interface workflows against the Widgets capabilities in the same row. **Implemented** means the listed capabilities have a connected interface and backend. **Partial** identifies available capabilities and remaining gaps. **Not available in GUI** means no reachable QML workflow was found. **RPC only** identifies backend functionality without a dedicated graphical workflow. The RPC console exposes additional backend operations beyond this inventory.

These implementation-support labels were established by source inspection at the pinned revisions, including interface wiring and existing test definitions. Separate runtime checks and their limits are recorded in the evidence pages linked below.

Runtime acceptance evidence is available in the [evidence pack](gui-feature-evidence/README.md), with one page per feature group, application captures, module links, test results, and explicit coverage gaps. The implementation comparison below remains source-based; acceptance has not been signed off.

| Feature | `bitcoin-core/gui` — supported subfeatures | `gui-qml` `qt6` — current support | Acceptance evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

Encryption applies to wallets containing private keys.
